create_interval_from_str: create a genomic Interval from a string like chr1:100-200:+ using Interval.from_str()
parse_variant_from_str: parse a genomic variant string like chr22:1024:A>C into a Variant object using Variant.from_str()
compute_interval_coverage: compute a coverage track for an Interval from a sequence of overlapping intervals using Interval.coverage()
intersect_intervals: compute the intersection of two sets of genomic intervals using intersect_intervals()
normalize_variant: normalize a genomic Variant by left-aligning reference and alternate bases using normalize_variant()
